notes: Sacred Ground daily flyer template (Thursday-style): gold standard is assets/sg-morning-flyer-2026-08-06-today-collage.png. Layout system — header WEEKDAY AT Sacred Ground + Mind • Body • Spirit • Community; LEFT stacked rounded event cards (icon + name + host + time + short keywords); RIGHT evocative graphics in clear zones; FOOTER circular logo + shopsacredground.com + 847-749-3922 + come-as-you-are energy. Dark elegant palette with gold accents (vary colors by day). Easy to read — not collage soup. Versions of this system, not exact clones. Date-keyed finished flyers are prebranded (skip overlays). NEVER include $, dollar amounts, ticket costs, or "$55"-style prices on flyer graphics, labels, or prompts. Empty days get a warm visit flyer. 1–3 events max.
